CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Oneirodex** is a self-hosted game library for a household: scan folders of DRM-free games and ROMs, identify them against IGDB, Steam and GOG, invite the family, download, play in the browser where a system supports it, and chat.
**What is in this repository**
- `unraid/oneirodex.xml` is the Community Apps template for the `cephyrixzyth/oneirodex` Docker image. The image is self-contained: PostgreSQL runs inside the container, so there is no second database container to set up. Point it at your games share (mounted read-only), keep appdata on the cache, and open the WebUI; the first visit runs the setup wizard. - The application source, Docker Compose files, desktop companion app and documentation live in the same repository.
**Support**
Questions and bug reports go to the project's [issue tracker](https://github.com/cephyrixzyth/oneirodex/issues). Setup notes for Unraid are in the [Unraid runbook](https://github.com/cephyrixzyth/oneirodex/blob/main/docs/runbooks/unraid-community-apps.md).
Oneirodex is for software you are authorised to share. It ships no BIOS or firmware and no piracy tooling.
